note: Per-endpoint security matrix for the JARVIS backend. 'current_security_mechanism' records LIVE behavior at build time; 'required_role_policy' is the SEC-1 target. Entries with evidence_verified=false are rule-based and must be source-reviewed before reliance. This matrix is the input to P3-P10 gating. SEC-1 post-hoc runtime annotations applied: statically-flagged HIGH cred_risk rows for host-op endpoints are mitigated at runtime (scrub/reject/deny-list/path-confine) and test-verified (tests/test_sec1_security.py).

authorization_tiers.admin: admin/owner role; write to roles, users, connectors, system host ops
authorization_tiers.privileged-host: admin/owner for host operations (system.py); deny-list enforced before auth on /launch
